title: Witness diagrams Image 1 and Image 2: red and white lights; kite-shaped outline of lights
description: Two simple digitally drawn witness diagrams. "Image 1" shows a magenta circle labeled "Red light" and a black square labeled "White light" on a horizontal line. "Image 2" shows a long, narrow kite- or blade-shaped black outline containing small white circles and one red dot, with the note "Outline was not definitive, but location of lights stayed in exact formation." Above them, numbered item 13 describes odd, fresh scrapes in the ground around a plant; marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 4.
